p: joyful noise unto the LORD: He prophecies that God's benefits in calling the Gentiles will be so great that they will have wonderful opportunity to praise his mercy and rejoice.
made us: He chiefly means concerning spiritual regeneration, by which we are his sheep and people.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving: He shows that God will not be worshipped, but by those means which he has appointed.
everlasting: He declares that we should never be weary in praising him, seeing his mercies toward us last forever.
